title: MRM Bike Racing : Moto Game 3D
description: About this game arrow_forward Get ready for an ultimate adrenaline rush with 'Moto Race Max (MRM); brought to you by Frolics, powered by Terafort! Immerse yourself in the exhilarating world of Moto Race Max where high-speed circuits and sharp turns redefine the essence of the bike racing game. MRM Bike Racing Gameplay Experience: MRM bike game presents an extraordinary motorcycle racing game experience with the following features: Dynamic Environment: We offer a realistic feel of the environment with changing daytime & weather. Race Instruction: A complete set of guidance to win the race. Pre-Race Visuals: Setting the stage with a Starting line, Waving flag, Vibrant track & grandstands. Commentary Voice: Real Voice Commentary is used to provide information on bike race progress & rider position. Navigation: A mini-map navigating to the finish line and moto rider position. Chanting Audience: The voice of the audience chanting the champions adds a layer of realism and excitement. Racing Tracks: MRM Bike Racing promises a blend of bike racing and fun in every track. Each circuit offers a challenging race, and a chance to test your MRM bike racing game skills against the world's best bike racing champions. MRM Bike Racing Gameplay Modes: Gear up for the ultimate mobile motorcycle racing experience. The bike racing game has designed some challenging modes to test your bike racing skills. Campaign: Our bike game allows you to carve the path to glory with 30 different challenges and climb the ranks to become a world motorcycle racing champion. Knockout: There will be 10 players on the racing track. The last bike rider will be eliminated after every 20 seconds. You must race at the first spot if you want to be a motorcycle racing champion. PvP: Compete against AI opponents of varying skill levels in intense PVP races in this bike game. To participate in the PVP race, you’ll pay the fee and get a double reward if you win the bike race. Game Controls: Experience the thrill of our exciting Bike Racing Game with 3 main controls featuring quick response that will make you feel seamlessly connected to your racing bike. Tap & Drag: You get the accelerator on the right side of the screen and control your heavy bike by sliding on the left side of the screen. Tilt or Buttons: You can also choose buttons or tilt controllers from the bike game settings tab. MRM Bike Racing Game Garage: We offer 10 different sports motorbikes and riders as well. Each can dominate the straights and carve through corners with razor-sharp precision. The customization option will be available soon. Here, moto racing enthusiasts will be able to upgrade their heavy bikes. Game Audio: We have recorded real motorbikes to give you a real feel of motorcycle racing. The dynamic audio system alters engine sounds based on RPM, gear changes, and throttle. You’ll also find every Bike Race with a distinctive heart-pounding soundtrack. USER INTERFACE & EXPERIENCE: The UI is straightforward with modern aesthetics. The live main menu allows users to navigate very easily. The vivid animations of bike riders also enhance the feeling of joy. Note: This bike racing game contains in-app purchases & in-App Ads, including paid random items.
